zh.headline: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.6 Sol 后企业营收大涨，重新夺回对 Anthropic 的优势
zh.observation: 今天的核心信号是 **"harness 时代"** 的到来：Nvidia 的研究直接证明 harness 比模型本身更重要，TrueFoundry 的 TrueForge 宣称比 Claude Managed Agents 便宜 30-75%，GitHub Trending 上 skills/harness 类项目霸榜。这意味着 AI 竞争的重心正从"训练更强的模型"转向"构建更聪明的 agent 框架"。另一个值得关注的趋势是**开源与本地模型的崛起**：DeepSeek 多模态模型逼近 Opus 4.8，Qwen3.8-27B 在 Reddit 上被验证为 agentic coding 利器，Meta 也开源了本地智能体模型。企业 AI 支出正在发生结构性转移，OpenAI 凭借 GPT-5.6 Sol 重新夺回优势，但 Anthropic 在企业安全领域的深耕（Claude Mythos 5 用于防御）同样值得关注。最后，Nvidia 60 亿美元收购 Poolside 和 Waymo 自研芯片，显示 AI 基础设施的垂直整合正在加速。

items.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.6 Sol 后企业营收大涨，重新夺回对 Anthropic 的优势
items.desc: OpenAI 本季度营收增长 35%，企业营收增长超 50%，Ramp 数据显示其企业 API 支出首次超越 Anthropic。
items.value: 企业 AI 支出粘性低，模型迭代直接改变市场格局

items.title: Nvidia 以 60 亿美元收购 Poolside 的 "Model Factory" 及 109 名员工

items.title: Anthropic 将最强模型 Claude Mythos 5 投入网络安全防御
items.desc: Claude Security 现已基于 Mythos 5 运行，可扫描代码库漏洞、提供 CWE 分类和严重性评级，并建议补丁。

en.headline: Nvidia to acquire Poolside's "Model Factory" and 109 employees for $6 billion

items.title: Nvidia to acquire Poolside's "Model Factory" and 109 employees for $6 billion
items.desc: Nvidia is paying $6 billion for software that builds AI models from startup Poolside, strengthening its AI software stack.
items.value: Nvidia expands from chips into model training software, reshaping AI infrastructure.

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol drives OpenAI's revenue surge as it regains ground on Anthropic
items.desc: OpenAI says revenue is up 35% this quarter, with enterprise revenue growing more than 50%, outpacing Anthropic in business API spending for the first time.
items.value: Model capability remains the top driver of enterprise AI spending; market dynamics shift.

items.title: Anthropic puts its most powerful model Claude Mythos 5 to work for cyber defense
items.desc: Its security scanner Claude Security is now powered by Mythos 5, scanning codebases for vulnerabilities and suggesting patches.
items.value: Frontier models land in security verticals, automating code audit at scale.

items.title: Waymo builds its own chip for its robotaxis, cutting reliance on Nvidia
items.desc: Waymo has developed its own chip for its autonomous taxi fleet.
items.value: Top autonomous driving company vertically integrates hardware, potentially reshaping the automotive AI chip market.

items.title: Meta spends hundreds of millions on Microsoft's AI services
items.desc: Meta has become one of Microsoft's biggest AI customers, according to Bloomberg.
items.value: AI compute and service procurement among tech giants is complexifying; cloud vendors benefit.

items.title: Anthropic changes data retention policy after enterprise pushback
items.desc: Anthropic is easing its controversial data storage policy, letting enterprise customers keep their own data going forward.
items.value: Enterprise data sovereignty demands are forcing AI vendors to adjust commercial terms.

items.title: Nvidia finds that simple linear math can replace costly AI model handoffs
items.desc: Nvidia researchers introduce a cross-model KV cache transfer technique that directly maps the prefilled KV cache from a source model into the target, reducing compute costs and latency in multi-LLM workflows.
items.value: Significantly reduces inference overhead in multi-model agent architectures; key optimization for long-horizon tasks.

items.title: Slack launches Slack Code, bringing AI coding into the group chat
items.desc: The new product embeds AI coding agents including Claude Code, Devin, GitHub Copilot, and Vercel's agent into dedicated Slack channels for team collaboration.
items.value: AI coding moves from personal terminal to team collaboration, changing software development workflows.

items.title: OpenAI offers Zero Data Retention for frontier models
items.desc: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.
items.value: Data privacy is a core enterprise adoption concern; this directly addresses compliance needs.

items.title: DeepSeek releases experimental multimodal model V4-Flash-Vision-Exp
items.desc: The model adds image understanding to V4-Flash's text capabilities, approaching or beating Opus 4.8 on DeepSeek's multimodal agent benchmarks.
items.value: Open-source multimodal models approach closed-source top models, offering cost-effective alternatives.

items.title: OpenAI's GPT-Image-2 can now generate images without a background
items.desc: Transparent background support is previewed through the API, with the alpha channel baked in during image generation, reportedly beating conventional background removal.
items.value: Streamlines post-generation processing; direct value for design and e-commerce.

items.title: Meta launches Meta AI Mac app
items.desc: Users can share their screen with Meta's AI chatbot for suggestions, answers, or content creation, with dictation support across all apps.
items.value: Meta accelerates desktop AI entry, competing directly with OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.title: It's Greg Brockman's OpenAI now
items.desc: After a turbulent year, Greg Brockman's role and influence at OpenAI have expanded significantly as the company prepares for an IPO.
items.value: Leadership changes signal strategic shifts at OpenAI; watch for product roadmap implications.

items.title: OpenAI introduces AI Futures blog
items.desc: The new blog explores how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom.
items.value: OpenAI strengthens its voice on AI's societal impact, shaping industry discourse.

items.title: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
items.desc: Nvidia research shows AI agents can perform well through fine-tuning even if the underlying model isn't great at the task.
items.value: Research focus shifts from models to harnesses, offering new insights for agent engineering.

items.title: Meta open-sources agentic model with local running, vision, and tool calling
items.desc: Meta released an agentic model that runs locally with vision understanding and tool calling capabilities.
items.value: Open-source locally deployable agentic models offer new options for privacy-sensitive and enterprise scenarios.

items.title: Nvidia's cross-model KV cache transfer technique
items.desc: Researchers introduce a technique to directly map a source model's prefilled KV cache into a target model, avoiding recomputation from scratch and significantly reducing compute costs and latency in multi-LLM workflows.
items.value: Solves a core bottleneck in multi-model agent architectures, dramatically improving inference efficiency.

items.title: τ_0-VLA: A Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation
items.desc: Formulates high-level subtask generation as a compute-scalable inference problem guided by world models, offering a new paradigm for long-horizon robot manipulation.
items.value: Provides dynamic compute allocation for long-horizon robot tasks, improving success rates on complex tasks.

items.title: FlashPrefill V2: Block-Sparse Prefill Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
items.desc: Evolves FlashPrefill with block-sparse attention to significantly reduce the compute bottleneck during long-context prefilling, moving closer to production deployment.
items.value: Directly improves inference speed and throughput for long-context LLM serving; critical for production.

items.title: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?
items.desc: Introduces a repository-level benchmark for scientific software engineering with 119 tasks, evaluating coding agents in scientific software repair.
items.value: Fills the evaluation gap for coding agents in scientific computing, advancing AI for Science engineering.

items.title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement
items.desc: First benchmark specifically evaluating AI systems' ability to design training algorithms, directly relevant to the feasibility of recursive self-improvement (RSI).
items.value: Provides a standardized testbed for evaluating and advancing AI self-improvement capabilities.

items.title: TinyCast: Probabilistic Zero-Shot Forecasting with Computed Periodicity
items.desc: An attention-free zero-shot forecaster with only 146,505 parameters that computes periodic structure rather than learning it, smaller than every zero-shot entry on the GIFT-Eval board.
items.value: Extremely small model achieving zero-shot forecasting offers new approach for resource-constrained scenarios.

items.title: Repo0: Design-Driven Zero-to-All Code Generation
items.desc: A continuous structural evolution framework enabling agents to construct entire software projects directly from natural-language requirements while maintaining modular repository architecture throughout.
items.value: Elevates code generation from single files/functions to whole repositories; important step toward fully automated software development.

items.title: Inject, Align, Recover: Staged Post-Training for Retrieval-Free Document Knowledge Internalization
items.desc: A three-stage post-training framework converting a fixed corpus into usable parametric knowledge for retrieval-free question answering.
items.value: Offers retrieval-free solution for knowledge-intensive tasks, reducing inference latency and infrastructure costs.

items.title: 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video
items.desc: Reconstructs 4D humans from uncalibrated monocular video by generating reconstruction-grade multiview-consistent videos and lifting them into 4D Gaussian Splatting.
items.value: Dramatically lowers the barrier to 4D content creation; significant value for film, gaming, VR/AR.

items.title: Listening Forward: Next Patch Embedding Prediction Enables Scalable Audio Learners
items.desc: Proposes a "next element prediction" pre-training approach similar to language modeling for audio representation learning.
items.value: Simplifies audio self-supervised pre-training; could become a new paradigm for audio representation learning.

items.title: SWE-bench Science
items.desc: See above.
items.value: Provides a dedicated evaluation benchmark for coding
